coverage.title: Introducing Anthropic models on Amazon Bedrock for in-region inference in Seoul and Singapore

summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 and Claude Sonnet 5 with in-region inference in Seoul, and Claude Sonnet 5 in Singapore.
